title: SRD 5.2.1 conformance check: diagonal, cover, LOS, AoE shapes
description: Close the M1 gap "geometry checked only against our own rule". Read the SRD 5.2.1 text (official CC-BY PDF) and record, with page/section citations, what it says about diagonal movement, cover, line of effect and the sphere/cube/cone/line/cylinder templates. Compare each with packages/engine/src/map (geometry.ts default 5 ft per diagonal and the 5-10-5 alternate, cover.ts, los.ts, areas). Where the SRD is silent, state it and keep the documented convention. Produce a mismatch list; do not change engine code (M2-02 does).
acceptance: Report cites SRD section/page for each of: diagonal rule, cover grades, line of effect, five area templates
Each engine convention is marked MATCH, MISMATCH or SRD-SILENT
Every MISMATCH has a failing test case added under tests/e2e that encodes the SRD behaviour (skipped with a reason until M2-02 lands)
docs/decisions.md open item "Diagonal movement convention (M1-18)" is resolved or re-raised with the exact question
verify: pnpm --filter e2e exec vitest run m2-srd-geometry

title: Apply SRD geometry fixes and re-pass the 100-case gate
description: Implement every MISMATCH from M2-01 in packages/engine/src/map and update the 100-case geometry gate fixtures that encoded the old convention. If M2-01 found no mismatch, close this ticket with a one-paragraph note and no code change.
acceptance: Skipped SRD-geometry tests from M2-01 are enabled and pass
pnpm --filter @game/rules-engine test:geometry still reports 100/100 (fixtures changed only where M2-01 proves the SRD differs, each change cites the SRD section in a comment)
Property suite still passes at 500 runs
Scripted crypt scenario (seed 2901) still ends in CombatEnded, or its golden replay is regenerated and the diff explained in the PR
verify: pnpm --filter e2e exec vitest run m2-srd-geometry

title: Catalog reconciliation against SRD 5.2.1 lists and stats
description: Close the M1 gap "catalog counts not reconciled". Write a script that extracts the SRD 5.2.1 index (species, backgrounds, 12 classes and subclasses, spells level 0-3, monsters CR 0-5, conditions, weapons/armor/gear) and diffs it by name against packages/engine/catalog. Spot-diff stats for a stratified sample (at least 10% of monsters, 25 spells, every class level 1-5 feature table) against SRD text. Output a gap list that feeds M2-04.
acceptance: Script output lists missing, extra and name-mismatched entries per kind, with counts
Sample diff covers >= 10% of monsters (stratified by CR), >= 25 spells and all 12 classes level 1-5 tables, each discrepancy cited to SRD section
Report states exactly which kinds were reconciled fully and which only by sample
Script is re-runnable and exits non-zero while the missing-entry list is non-empty (wired as expected-fail until M2-04)

title: Fill catalog gaps and correct stat discrepancies
description: Add the entries M2-03 found missing (spells, monsters, equipment, subclass features as applicable) and fix wrong stats, in the existing JSON files under packages/engine/catalog, keeping scope gating (spells <= L3, monsters <= CR 5, classes L1-5). Magic items stay out (deferred to M3).
acceptance: Reconcile script exits 0 for all kinds covered by the SRD index

catalogVersion changes and the M1 proof test that records it still passes
No entry without srd source reference

title: Quick build and legality for levels 1-5, all 12 classes
description: M1 proved quick build at level 1 only. Reuse the level-up legality from M1-16; do not add a second validator.
acceptance: 36+ builds (12 classes x levels 1..5, >= 1 seed each) pass validateCharacter with zero violations
Level-up sequence 1->5 for each class produces the same sheet as quick build at level 5 for the same choices (test)
5 new illegal fixtures at level >= 2 (bad ASI, over-prepared spells, wrong slots, missing subclass, wrong HP) rejected with distinct violation codes

title: Scenario variety: more scripted combats and golden replays
description: M1 proved one authored crypt fight. Add at least 6 scripted no-LLM scenarios through the existing harness (packages/engine/src/scripted): ranged kiting with cover, difficult terrain and a closed door, a caster party using concentration, death saves to stable and to dead, a grapple/prone movement case, and a 4-vs-6 fight on the forest map. title: ADR-022: DM turn protocol, tool schemas, prompt layout, recorded-LLM format
description: Turn architecture.md sections 2-4 and 16 into an implementable ADR. Decide: the exact tool set for M2 (architecture 3.2 minus deferred tools, see overview), error codes and hints, entity-reference scheme (catalog id / session entity id / marker id / optionId), one-narration-per-turn rule, how roll events precede narration, prompt block order and token budgets, retry and fallback narration text policy, recorded-LLM file format, turn-seed derivation, and the event types added for DM turns. title: Schema: DM tool contract, DM-turn events, registry, endpoint config, usage
description: In packages/schema add zod schemas for every M2 tool call and result/error ({ok,events,summary} | {error,hint}), the DM-turn events (TurnStarted with seed, NarrationChunk, NarrationCompleted, TurnReverted-ready shape, ToolRejected, SceneClosed, RecapReady), registry entities (npc, location, quest, flag, ruling), scene summary, EndpointConfig/EndpointProfile (no key material in the client-facing type) and UsageEntry. acceptance: Each schema parses a valid fixture and rejects an invalid one (table test)
Tool arg schemas reject any x/y/coordinate field (test) and unknown entity ref formats

title: Tool executor: loot, quests, registry upserts, rests, rulings

title: Endpoint probe and tool-mode selection (native, json-schema)

Pick mode native or json-schema and store the EndpointProfile with a "qualified" flag that stays false until an eval record exists (M2-39). qualified stays false with no eval record

title: Operator endpoint config: storage, encrypted key, API, connection test
description: Add migration + routes for fast/frontier/moderate endpoint slots (base URL, model, API style, key). Key is encrypted at rest with a server secret, write-only over the API, never logged. Save returns probe result and "not qualified" marker

title: Usage metering v0
description: Record one UsageEntry per endpoint call (purpose, model id, input/output/cached tokens or estimate flag, latency, retries, error) in Postgres, linked to table and turn, and expose per-table and aggregate read endpoints to the operator. Prices, budgets and wrap-up mode are M5.
acceptance: Every adapter call in the orchestrator test run produces exactly one entry (test)
Estimated tokens are flagged as estimated

Metering failure never fails a DM turn (test)

title: Outbound endpoint guard: SSRF policy and secret handling
description: The operator supplies base URLs, so the server will fetch arbitrary hosts. Add an outbound policy: https required unless an explicit operator "allow local/private hosts" flag is set (needed for local models), block link-local and cloud metadata addresses always, re-resolve DNS at connect time (rebinding), disable redirects, response size and time limits. Runbook note lists where keys live and how to rotate

title: dm-orchestrator: prompt builder and state projection
description: Build the per-turn prompt in the ADR-022 order: byte-stable static prefix (persona, rules cheat-sheet, tool schemas for the active mode), session-stable block (party, premise, scene summary), dynamic block (compact state projection, engine describe() text in combat, registry facts for named entities, last N turns, this round inputs), retrieved memory slot (filled by M2-26). acceptance: Prefix is byte-identical across two sessions with the same catalogVersion and mode (test)
Token budget per block enforced by truncation with a recorded reason; unit tests at the limits
Player text containing "ignore previous instructions" stays inside the quoted block and system text is unchanged (snapshot test)
In combat the projection contains describe() output and no raw coordinates beyond what describe() prints

title: dm-orchestrator: tool loop, validation, retries, fallback, streaming
description: Implement runTurn(roomView, resolvedInputs) -> stream of roll events then narration chunks. Validate every tool call with the schema and executor; on rejection re-prompt with the error and hint (max 2 retries) then fall back to a safe narrated outcome with no state change. One narration per turn (combat: per action), one in-flight turn per table, queue the rest. Rolls are emitted before narration completes. Narration containing positions is checked against engine describe() output (contradiction counter for R-N5).
acceptance: Scripted recorded-LLM runs: valid call, one invalid then valid, three invalid -> fallback with unchanged state hash
Roll events are emitted before the final narration chunk (ordering test)
Second submit during generation is queued, not interleaved (test)
Cancelled turn leaves no partial state (test)
Contradiction counter increments on a fixture narration that moves a token

title: Recorded-LLM and fixed-seed mode

Draw the 64-bit turn seed from the OS CSPRNG normally, from a fixed value in test mode, and write it in TurnStarted. Replay must be a first-class path used by CI and e2e.

Seed is never present in any prompt or client message (test)
